page.overview:
What is Star Wars?

Attack of the Clones The Clone Wars Revenge of the Sith The Bad Batch Obi-Wan Kenobi Solo: A Star Wars Story Rebels Andor Rogue One: A Star Wars Story A New Hope The Empire Strikes Back Return of the Jedi The Mandalorian The Book of Boba Fett Ahsoka Skeleton Crew The Mandalorian and Grogu The Force Awakens The Last Jedi Resistance The Rise of Skywalker

Legends The Yoda Chronicles The Freemaker Adventures Rebuild the Galaxy

Buildable Figures Buildable Galaxy Mechs Microfighters Mini

Star Wars is the first and current licensed theme introduced in 1999. The theme is based on material from the Star Wars franchise of films, cartoon series, comic books, video games, and other media. The theme covers all nine main films, along with the Star Wars: The Clone Wars movie and TV series, the Star Wars Rebels TV series, the Star Wars: The Bad Batch TV series, The Mandalorian, The Book of Boba Fett, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Ahsoka and Skeleton Crew TV series and anthology films, such as Rogue One: A Star Wars Story, Solo: A Star Wars Story and The Mandalorian and Grogu. Also, some Expanded Universe sets have been released, with four The Old Republic sets released in the second wave of 2012, the first and second wave of 2013, and one The Force Unleashed set released in 2008.
